_about: Shown once on each phone after it installs a new Android update (not on a first install). Replace the list with what this update changes, in plain words, each time an Android update is approved and built.
items: Take manifest photo in the Manifest check opens the camera straight away to photograph a manifest page, next to Upload manifest photos for photos you’ve already taken.

Live read manifest, in the Manifest check: hold the phone over a printed manifest and move it slowly down the page. Each number printed after “LPN:” is added to the manifest numbers as soon as it has been read clearly twice, with a green flash. Remove last takes one back out.
